Seven weights have greedy cost 20 and exhaustive 64-pattern optimum 18.

value.rationale: Determines a natural exact first-failure horizon for least-loaded greedy under the descending processing-time order. The result applies to all real nonnegative weights, not a finite table, and gives a strictly positive seven-good witness; it distinguishes prefix-area optimization from classic final makespan and one-item fair allocation.
